item.title: Ongoing issue where it's very dangerous pulling out from Naunton Lane onto Leckhampton Road, 19th October
item.description:
Double yellow lines need to be extended to prevent parking so close to the junction and over grown foliage on tree trunks should be cut back regularly to prevent obstructing drivers What 3 words for this location are ///duck.drums.sober I witness multiple near misses every week when drivers are struggling with visibility when pulling out of this junction. In fact, I've almost had a collision myself. This would be easily rectified by taking these simple measures. I have only driven this way over the summer and in daylight, it must be awful when the roads are wet and it's dark.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Naunton Lane, Warden Hill, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
